```{r packages_and_functions, include=FALSE}
library(Signac)
library(Seurat)
library(knitr)
library(future)
set.seed(1234)

source('common.R')
```

## Parallelization

```{r parallelize, include=FALSE}

# Assign the number of cores for parallelization
ncpus <- future::availableCores()

# Adjust max memory allowed
options(future.globals.maxSize=40000 * 1024^2,
        mc.cores=ncpus)

# Parallelize the run
plan("multicore", workers=ncpus)


```


## Set variables

We'll get all the sample and replicate specific variables listed in samples.tsv and units.tsv, respectively. We'll also set paths to input files.

```{r variables}
seurat_inputs = unlist(strsplit(params[['seurats']], ' '))
cat('Input Seurat objects: \n')
print(seurat_inputs)

config_path = params[['config']]
```

```{r input_config}
config = yaml::read_yaml(file = config_path)
```


```{r get_analysis_group}
# groups = config[['weighted_nn']][['groups']]
# group = groups[[1]]

group = config[['weighted_nn']][['groups']][[ params[["seurat"]] ]]

group_name = params[["seurat"]]
print('Current group:')
print(group_name)

targets = group[['input_groups']]
idx = grepl(pattern = paste(paste0('/', targets), collapse = "|"), seurat_inputs)
seurat_inputs = seurat_inputs[idx]

print('Seurat objects in use:')
print(seurat_inputs)
```

## Read in data

Read in Seurat objects.

```{r input_seurat}
seurat_list <- lapply(seq_along(seurat_inputs), function(x){
	s_in = readRDS(seurat_inputs[x])
	return(s_in)
})
cat('Input sample list: \n')
print(seurat_list)
```


## Cluster


```{r cluster}
# assay_names = group[['assay_name']]
# 
# print('assay names')
# print(assay_names)

reductions = group[['reduction']]

print('reductions')
print(reductions)

umap_dims = group[['umap_dims']]
print('dimension range')
print(umap_dims)

if (!any(is.integer(unlist(umap_dims)))) {
    dims_list = lapply(seq_along(assay_name), function(x) {
        u_seq = 1:50
        return(u_seq)
    })
} else {
    if (is.list(umap_dims)) {
        dims_list = lapply(seq_along(umap_dims), function(x) {
            u = umap_dims[[x]]
            u_seq = seq(from = u[1], to = u[2])
            return(u_seq)
        })
    } else {
        dims_list = dim_vals_to_list(
            dim_vals = umap_dims
        )
    }
}

print('dims_list dims')
print(dims_list)

res = group[['resolution']]

if (is.null(res)) {
    res = 0.8
}

print('resolution')
print(res)

# weighted nearest neirbor required both matrices to have equal barcodes
common_names = intersect(colnames(seurat_list[[1]]), colnames(seurat_list[[2]]))

if (length(common_names) > 0) {
    print('Common barcodes found for selected assays. Starting weighted NN graphing')
    
    # sort seurat list to be sure
    reducs_present = lapply(seq_along(seurat_list), function(x) {
        dr_names = names(seurat_list[[x]]@reductions)
        idx = !(dr_names %in% "umap")
        dr_names = dr_names[idx]
        return(dr_names)
    })
    print('reductions present in each seurat object')
    print(reducs_present)
    
    idx = sapply(seq_along(reductions), function(x) {
        idy = which(reductions %in% reducs_present[[x]])
        return(idy)
    })
    print(idx)
    
    if (length(idx) < 2) {
        print("Not all reductions listed in config file found in input objects!")
        q()
    }
    
    seurat_list = seurat_list[idx]
    
    # keep only cells/barcodes common to both data sets
    # some may have been removed during qc, etc
    seurat_list[[1]] = subset(seurat_list[[1]],
                              cells = common_names)
    seurat_list[[2]] = subset(seurat_list[[2]],
                              cells = common_names)
    
    # extract 
    reduction1 = reductions[1]
    assay_used1 = seurat_list[[1]]@reductions[[reduction1]]@assay.used
    assay1 = seurat_list[[1]]@assays[[assay_used1]]
    dr1 = seurat_list[[1]][[reduction1]]
    dr1_name = paste0(reduction1, assay_used1)
    
    reduction2 = reductions[2]
    assay_used2 = seurat_list[[2]]@reductions[[reduction2]]@assay.used
    assay2 = seurat_list[[2]]@assays[[assay_used2]]
    dr2 = seurat_list[[2]][[reduction2]]
    dr2_name = paste0(reduction2, assay_used2)
    
    seurat = seurat_list[[1]]
    seurat[[assay_used2]] = assay2
    
    # seurat = merge(seurat_list[[1]], seurat_list[[2]])
    seurat[[dr1_name]] = dr1
    seurat[[dr2_name]] = dr2
    
    reduc_list = list(dr1_name, dr2_name)
    
    seurat <- FindMultiModalNeighbors(
        object = seurat,
        reduction.list = reduc_list,
        dims.list = dims_list
    )
    
    print('finished finding multimodal neighbor')
    
    seurat = RunUMAP(
        object = seurat,
        nn.name = "weighted.nn",
        reduction.name = "wnn_umap",
        reduction.key = "wnnUMAP_"
    )
    
    seurat = FindClusters(
        object = seurat,
        graph.name = "wsnn",
        algorithm = 3,
        resolution = res
    )
    
}

```

```{r umap}
  group.by = "orig.ident"
)

plot

  reduction = "wnn_umap",

)

plot
```


## Save Seurat object

```{r save}
# save main seurat object
saveRDS(object=seurat, file=params[['seurat_out']])
print('Done saving seurat object.')

# save barcodes for later use (combining multiple processed objects)
barcodes = colnames(seurat)
saveRDS(object=barcodes, file=params[['barcodes_out']])
cat('Done saving cell barcodes.')
```
